verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document adaptive quality when the connection degrades, or user controls for resolution and frame rate. Codec support (VP8/VP9/AV1, H264/H265) and a generic "90 options" claim are related but do not show either capability. A community mention of a shrink-to-fit view is display scaling, not resolution or frame-rate control.

support.subject: As a power user, quality adapts when the link falls behind, and I can set resolution and frame rate myself
